constructor_uses: Initial response-free plans only: observed X/y, fixed theta/alpha, first-action x, source-specific step1 Sobol pool; all114 action sets across43 nontrivial contexts durably constructed before grading loads trajectories.
identical_point_information: Both readers use the same pending-point bound and the same archived two-trial-space evaluator on the whole eligible pool; nonnegative-set joint bounds also clamp the pending response to its available point lower.
H1_target: First action and one posterior-mean continuation; paid baseline endpoint completed at the same H1 horizon. This does not certify H5.
bound_library: Full eligible1024-point source pool plus pending points; within-state exact cache sharing across first actions;45000 unique-design cap unchanged.

independent_study_gate: Validated downstream judgment increment AND complete-cost benefit AND an H5 reachable-history extension are required. Set shrinkage alone is insufficient.
runtime_policy: Record existing runtime differences; require frozen physical-engine hashes and Sobol-pool hashes to match.
